PART III - LANDS NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT NO. 21 OF 1998 (SECTION 55) Reference the intestate property of late Mrs. Liyana Pedige Puspa Lalani who resides in the village of Kubaloluwa, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mirigama, in the District of Gampaha. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mrs. Liyana Pedige Puspa La-lani described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 03rd August 2016 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, expert action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998. K.A.K.RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 20th June, 2016. SCHEDULE Divisional Village Cadastral Parcel No. Extent of Land Certificate Office of Secretary’s Division Map No. of Title No. Registration

(Hectare) Mirigama Kubaloluwa 510260 Block 01 0.0386 0018402 Gampaha Parcel No. 36 N.B.- Letters claiming a right to intestate property should mention the Cadastral Map number, parcel number and the entitlement of the claimant to claim such property. The top left-hand corner of the envelope should bear the phrase “Application for Intestate Property.” 07 - 1151 / 1
